lane: صَيْدَنٌ A firm, strong, or compact, building. (M.) === And A firm, strong, or compact, garment, or piece of cloth: (M:) or a [garment of the kind called] كِسَآء that is stout, or strong, or that is thick, or compact, in texture. (K.) === And A king; (S, M, K;) because of the firmness of his rule, or his state, or condition; as also ↓صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ and صَيْدَلَانِىٌّ. (M.) === And A fox; (S, M, K;) as also ↓صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ: (K:) or الصَّيْدَنُ is one of the names thereof. (TA.) === And The hyena. (K.) === See also صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ. === Also A species of fly, that makes a buzzing sound over the herbage. (IKh, TA.) === And, as also صَيْدَلٌ, Stones [i. e. pieces of ore] of silver: to which are likened what are termed حِجَارَةٌ العَقَاقِيرِ. (IDrst, TA. [See صَيْدَلٌ; and see also صَيْدَانٌ, below.])

entries.text: الصيدن: الضبع، والكساء الصفيق، والملك، والثعلب، ودويبة تعمل لنفسها بيتا في الأرض، وتعميه، كالصيدناني فيهما. والصيدناني: الصيدلاني.
